items.title: Trade Desk (TTD) Adds Show Level CTV Targeting In New Data Partnership
items.summary: The Trade Desk (NasdaqGM:TTD) announced a new partnership with Gracenote to bring show-level content intelligence into its platform for connected TV campaigns. The collaboration aims to give advertisers more granular targeting, planning, and measurement tools for programmatic CTV advertising. Gracenote, a Nielsen company, will feed detailed content data into The Trade Desk to support more precise CTV ad delivery and reporting.
